core_obligations: The source constructs a quotient game from subspace-based questions and establishes that the quotient has genuine 2-to-1 constraints, while retaining completeness after identifications and decoding soundness from the source agreement hypothesis. The hypothesis remains explicit. This quotient/completeness mechanism and standard small-value soundness differ from the earlier transitive 2-to-2 list-coloring reduction; related corollaries are not counted separately.
